title: Arrest Of Male Russian Found In Possession Of A Sum Of $10,000.00 In Fapi

page_data.en:
copy
C.I.S. Division.
C. & S. Br. H'q.
March 4, 1943.

C.I.S. Misc.34/43

Diary Number:- 1

227
Arrest of a male Russian found in possession 65-3-43
of a sum of $10,000.00 in fapi

At 3 p.m. on the 4th March 1943 D.S.I. Li Ying Ming
received information to the effect that a male Russian was
making an attempt to exchange a sum of $10,000.00 in fapi to C.R.B
banknotes at a rate of $1.00 C.R.B. to $1.10 of old fapi bank-
notes and that this transaction is to take place at 343/15 Ward
Road.

Acting upon this information and instructions of
Officer i/c C.I.S., a posse of detectives consisting of D.S.I.
Li Ying Ming, C.D.Ss. 228, 420, C.D.C. 423 and the undersigned
made a visit at the noted address where the described hereunder
two men were arrested at 4 p.m. 4-3-43.

1. German P. Demintseff, age 40, Russian,
Engineer, unemployed at present, residing
at 120/5 Baikal Road.

On the person of G.P. Demintseff, a sum of $10,000
in old fapi was found.

2. Wong Ka Yoong (王克荣), age 27, Shantung,
M/Shop-assistant, residing at 292 Ward Road.

G.P. Demintseff admitted that he intended to pass
the seized $10,000.00 in fapi to the 2nd mentioned who promised
to him to exchange the seized $10,000.00 in fapi for $9,000.00
in C.R.B. banknotes.

No political aspect could be attached to this case
and there was no intention on the part of these two men to
smuggle the seized money into the interior of China. In view
of this and in accordance of Officer i/c C.I.S. the arrested
both men were cautioned against their illegal intentions to put
the forbidden currency into circulation and were set free at
5.30 p.m.

P. T. O.

刑事侦缉处。
刑事与特别分部总部。
1943年3月4日。

C.I.S. Misc.34/43

日志编号：- 1

227
一名持有面值10,000.00元法币的俄国男子被捕 65-3-43

1943年3月4日下午3时，警探长李英明（Li Ying Ming）接获情报，称一名俄国男子试图在沃德路（Ward Road）343号15室，以1.10元旧法币兑换1.00元中国储备银行（C.R.B.）钞票的汇率，将10,000.00元法币兑换为中国储备银行钞票。

根据此情报及刑事侦缉处主管警官的指示，由警探长李英明、刑事侦缉警员228号、420号、刑事侦缉警佐423号及签署人组成的侦探小队前往上述地址，并于下午4时逮捕了下述两名男子（1943年3月4日）。

1. 格尔曼·P·德明采夫（German P. Demintseff），40岁，俄国人，
工程师，目前失业，居住于
贝加尔路（Baikal Road）120号5室。

在格尔曼·P·德明采夫身上搜出面值10,000元的旧法币。

2. 王克荣（Wong Ka Yoong），27岁，山东人，
男店员，居住于沃德路（Ward Road）292号。

格尔曼·P·德明采夫承认，他打算将查获的10,000.00元法币交给上述第二人，后者曾向他承诺将查获的10,000.00元法币兑换为9,000.00元中国储备银行钞票。

本案不涉及政治因素，且这两名男子并无将查获款项走私至中国内地的意图。鉴于此，并根据刑事侦缉处主管警官的指示，对两名被捕男子就其非法流通禁用货币的意图提出警告，并于下午5时30分将其释放。

下转第2页。

Instructions for disposal of the seized $10,000.00
in fapi are respectfully solicited.
Wayside Station informed.

(Sgd.) P. Konovaloff
D. S. I.

O. i/c C.I.S. & N.S.
J. & S. Br. H.Q.

（签名）P. 科诺瓦洛夫（P. Konovaloff）
